show.description:
Black Mine's Hidden Dragon" is a gripping show set in a remote coal town where a mysterious newcomer exposes buried secrets and power struggles.
As tension builds between miners and corrupt officials, hidden identities come to light.
A tale of revenge, redemption, and resilience unfolds in under ten minutes.
